text: Program Description 1. Program Overview Editor Notes: Computer Science and Technology is one of the characteristic majors of Jiangsu province. Provides a strong technical background for students planning to begin careers upon graduation and for those interested in graduate study in computer science. Emphasis is placed on developing both the software programming and hardware design necessary to begin and enhance an individual's career. Graduates of this program are well prepared for immediate employment in either the computer industry or many other businesses that increasingly rely on computer science. 2. Internship Practice and Graduation Editor Notes: The graduate employment rates has been among the best. The school has several computer laboratories with high class servers where students are practicing during their studies. Also through associations at the university students can connect with companies which can help them conduct an internship. Graduates engage in the computer software and hardware applications, development, research and teaching, etc. in enterprises, government departments, research departments and institutions of higher learning, also can apply for further studies in computer science graduate. 4. Brief Introduction to Jiangsu University(JSU) Editor Notes: JSU ranks 39 among >3000 higher educational institutions in China. Jiangsu University , situated in a beautiful and well-known historic and cultural city on the southern bank of the Yangtze River - Zhenjiang, is a comprehensive teaching-and-research-type university featuring engineering, one of its five chief fields: engineering, medicine, science, management and humanities. About Overseas Education College (OEC) Editor Notes: OEC is responsible for foreign students' admission, academic affairs, routine administration and organizing Chinese international education. OEC has established a scholarship system and is now providing students with scholarships of different types. OEC pays attention to cultural inheritance and therefore organizes foreign students to take part in various activities in and outside university. OEC has always been trying to help foreign students understand Chinese culture and feel the happiness of study in China. 6.
